annotations.title: utilpeek: hash text or bytes (SHA-2, SHA-3, BLAKE2b, Keccak-256, MD5, CRC-32)

description: utilpeek: Hash text or bytes: sha256, keccak256, blake2b, md5, crc32, ... For a keyed HMAC use hmac_sign_verify. Returns hex digests of the text (as UTF-8) or base64 bytes you send. md5 and sha1 are for checksums, not security. Send exactly one of text or base64 (else 422 invalid_request); bad base64 is a 422 invalid_base64. The input is never echoed. Typically under 0.1 s (keccak256 about 2 s per MB). Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/hash-text-api.html

algorithms.description: Any of md5, sha1, sha256 (default), sha512, sha3_256, blake2b, keccak256, crc32.
algorithms.title: Algorithms

base64.description: Raw bytes as standard base64 (at most 1 MB decoded); send text OR base64.
base64.title: Base64

text.description: Text, hashed as UTF-8 (at most 1 MB); send text OR base64.
